figures.name: 01_score_distributions
figures.title: Score Distributions by Note-Taking Method
figures.caption: Dots: participants; boxes: middle 50%; line: median; diamond: mean. All observations retained.

figures.name: 02_histograms
figures.title: Overall Score Distributions
figures.caption: Identical bins and axes; the last bin includes 100.

figures.name: 03_normal_probability
figures.title: Normal Probability Plots of Overall Scores
figures.caption: Tail departures and bounded scores matter especially for individual prediction, variance and tolerance intervals.

figures.name: 04_mean_difference_intervals
figures.title: Mean Differences and 95% Confidence Intervals
figures.caption: Intervals are individual 95% intervals, not simultaneous family intervals. Secondary p-values are Holm-adjusted separately.

figures.name: 05_hypothesis_test
figures.title: Welch Two-Sample t-Test for Overall Scores
figures.caption: Shading represents both tails at least as far from zero as the observed statistic. The p-value is not the probability that the null is true.

figures.name: 06_question_type
figures.title: Mean Scores by Question Type and Note-Taking Method
figures.caption: Lines summarize means, not individual change over time. The formal comparison uses conceptual minus factual within each participant.

figures.name: 07_lecture_means
figures.title: Mean Overall Scores by Lecture and Note-Taking Method
figures.caption: Small subgroups have wide intervals. These are descriptive means with marginal t intervals, not five independent confirmatory tests.

figures.name: 08_adjusted_comparison
figures.title: Unadjusted and Lecture-Adjusted Mean Differences
figures.caption: Adjusted result uses an additive model with lecture indicators and a common typing effect; its approximate 95% interval uses HC3 standard errors and a normal critical value.

figures.name: 09_regression_diagnostics
figures.title: Lecture-Adjusted Regression Diagnostics
figures.caption: Residual shape, unequal spread and influential observations limit model accuracy. Dashed Cook threshold 4/n is a screening rule, not an exclusion rule.

figures.name: 10_factual_conceptual
figures.title: Association Between Factual and Conceptual Scores
figures.caption: Each point is one participant. Correlation is exploratory and does not demonstrate causation; overall is not correlated with its own components.

figures.name: 11_illustrative_threshold
figures.title: Proportions of Participants Scoring at Least 70
figures.caption: 70 is an exploratory threshold, not an official pass mark. Error bars are Wilson 95% confidence intervals.

figures.name: 12_power_planning
figures.title: Statistical Power by Assumed Mean Difference
figures.caption: Normal planning approximation at two-sided alpha .05, with common SD estimated from this sample. This is scenario analysis, not evidence for the null.

figures.name: 13_interval_purposes
figures.title: Confidence, Prediction and Tolerance Intervals
figures.caption: Mean CIs and prediction intervals are 95%; tolerance intervals have 90% population content and 95% confidence under normality. Values beyond 100 expose the normal model limitation; they are not clipped.
